opening.argument: The video is an instructional walkthrough of creating and growing an Instagram account, then preparing it for sale through a social account-selling service. It begins by showing viewers how to create an account and recommends following users as part of building the page. The presenter later demonstrates the sell-account process, including entering an email address and phone number, and describes example listing prices and TransferWise payment handling. Although the presentation includes easy-income framing, including the claim that viewers can earn $200-300 per month, it does not show an investment deposit, credential handover, or guaranteed payout. The material therefore supports a tutorial and account-sale demonstration more than a deceptive solicitation by the video itself.
